svg.aria-label: The path so far. 2023: started shipping full-stack products. 2024: AI engineering with open-source image and video models, and data annotation at Innodata. 2025: founded Capvise Group, COO at BackersStage, four rooms in four countries, built OmniSweep at ETHGlobal Buenos Aires. 2026: thirteen rooms, sat on the evaluation panel at Claude Impact Lab and open-sourced Cwtch.
